title: I Have Loved You
old_p1: Malachi was a prophet who lived over 400 years before Jesus was born. A prophet is a man who speaks for Heavenly Father.
Malachi’s people had come home to Jerusalem. But many had stopped thinking about the Lord.
The Lord gave Malachi a message. He said, “I have loved you.” The people asked, “How have You loved us?”
old_p2: The Lord said His name would be great “from the rising of the sun” to its “going down.” That means everywhere the sun shines, all over the world. The Lord was Jesus, speaking for Heavenly Father.
Jesus loves you too, every morning and every night. Tonight, hug yourself tight and feel how much you are loved.
p1: The people in Malachi's day had forgotten how much the Lord loved them. Some had stopped thinking about Him at all. Then the Lord sent Malachi with a gentle, powerful message: 'I have loved you.'
The people wondered how the Lord had shown His love. Malachi reminded them that the Lord's name would be great across the earth, from the first light of morning to the last glow of evening.
p2: Picture the sun rising over the hills. It shines on homes, fields, and roads. Later, that same sun slips below the horizon far away. The Lord's love reaches across the whole world too.

Jesus Christ loves His children in every place, through every morning and every night. That includes you. Tonight, wrap your arms around yourself like a warm hug and remember: you are always precious to Him.
note: Levi, 20 Nov 2026 ("Match up the story lantern stories with the published book"): p1 and p2 are the story words AS PRINTED in the published December book (We Have Waited for Him, on Amazon), first and second story page, word for word, so the Lantern, the app's Books page and the book a family bought read the same. The Christian edition reads God for Heavenly Father; p2_christian only where the printed words are Latter-day Saint teaching. The 29 Oct picture-book rewrite is kept as rewrite_p1/rewrite_p2.
rewrite_p1: Long before Jesus was born, Heavenly Father’s people came home to Jerusalem. But many had stopped thinking about the Lord.
So the Lord gave Malachi a message to share. It began with four warm words: “I have loved you.”
The people asked, “How have You loved us?” So the Lord reminded them. He had loved their family since long ago, all the way back to Jacob.
rewrite_p2: The Lord said His name would be great everywhere. From “the rising of the sun” to its “going down,” all would know Him. The Lord who spoke to Malachi was Jesus, speaking for Heavenly Father.
Jesus loves you too, every morning and every night. Tonight, say “I love you” to someone you love, and feel His love too.
rewrite_p2_christian: The Lord said His name would be great everywhere. From “the rising of the sun” to its “going down,” all would know Him. His love is that big.
Heavenly Father loves you too, every morning and every night. Tonight, say “I love you” to someone you love, and feel His love too.
